newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Spescom buys landlord for 18.6 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Spescom buys landlord for 18.6 mln rand.

text.p: Spescom Electronics Ltd on Monday announced that on May 1 it had acquired Spescom Electronics (Pty) Ltd for 18.6 million rand to be settled by a share issue.
Spescom Electronics (Pty) Ltd is the owner of the Midrand property north of Johannesburg where Spescom's headquarters are located.
The transaction was to be settled by the issue of 2.3 million Spescom ordinary shares at 680 cents per share.
"The transaction will have no dilutionary impact on the group's current year earnings," Spescom said.
